$comment: Runtime environment contract for the web/API task on ECS (audit P0-5). Terraform reads this file (modules/env/locals: app_secret_names); scripts/aws/check-env-contract.mjs fails CI when this file, the task definition and the application code disagree. 'terraform': secret = an app secret created in Secrets Manager with a placeholder and filled out-of-band; managed = a Terraform-generated secret with its own resource; environment = a plain task-definition value. 'required': the production process must not serve traffic without it.
architecture: A: ECS Fargate -> Supabase Postgres (PostgREST over HTTPS) + Upstash Redis (REST over HTTPS). No DATABASE_URL / REDIS_URL: the application does not read them.

variables.name: FURLPAY_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS
variables.consumer: lib/rateLimit.ts clientIp() — X-Forwarded-For hops appended by CloudFront + ALB; unset trusts client-set IP headers

variables.name: PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN
variables.consumer: lib/publicOrigin.ts — redirects, OAuth issuer, DPoP htu, CSRF host; on ECS the request URL is the bind address. Boot refuses it missing behind CloudFront (bootConfig.ts)

variables.name: FURLPAY_RP_ID
variables.consumer: lib/webauthn.ts — without it the RP ID falls back to 'localhost' off Vercel and every passkey ceremony fails

variables.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
variables.consumer: app/.well-known/apple-app-site-association/route.ts — 404 until set; iOS universal links and passkeys need it

variables.name: ORIGIN_VERIFY_SECRET
variables.consumer: lib/originVerify.ts (paired with the ALB listener rule)

variables.name: FURLPAY_SESSION_SECRET
variables.consumer: lib/session.ts — throws in production when unset

variables.name: FURLPAY_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.consumer: lib/adminIdentity.ts — production refuses to boot without it (no fallback admin)

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.consumer: lib/supabase.ts — the only database connection the app has

variables.name: KV_REST_API_URL
variables.consumer: lib/kv.ts — production refuses the in-memory fallback

terraform_only.$comment: Plain task environment that exists for operators/infra and is intentionally not read by the app.
